using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;

ll gcd(ll x, ll y) {
    while (y != 0) {
        ll t = y;
        y = x % y;
        x = t;
    }
    return x;
}

ll lcm(ll x, ll y) {
    return x / gcd(x, y) * y;
}

ld diff(ll x1, ll y1, ll x2, ll y2) {
    ll common = lcm(y1, y2);
    ll num1 = common / y1 * x1;
    ll num2 = common / y2 * x2;
    return ld(abs(num1 - num2)) / ld(common);
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    ll best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
    ld target = ld(x) / ld(y);
    
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        ll lo = 1, hi = 1000000;
        while (lo + 1 < hi) {
            ll mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            ld val = ld(mid) / ld(i);
            if (val < target) lo = mid;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        ll candidate = (diff(lo, i, x, y) > diff(hi, i, x, y)) ? hi : lo;
        if (diff(candidate, i, x, y) < diff(best_num, best_den, x, y)) {
            best_num = candidate;
            best_den = i;
        }
    }
    cout << best_num << "/" << best_den;
